name: Show Mistress
source:
The Show Mistress runs the Carnival of Curiosities and makes an appearance at all the main sideshow attractions. She keeps a watchful eye over all carnival proceedings and sometimes joins in! She’s an authoritative, boisterous woman of many talents and secrets.

[spoiler]She's the protagonist's mother.[/spoiler]
translation:
The Show Mistress runs the Carnival of Curiosities and makes an appearance at all the main sideshow attractions. She keeps a watchful eye over all carnival proceedings and sometimes joins in! She’s an authoritative, boisterous woman of many talents and secrets.

[spoiler]She's the protagonist's mother.[/spoiler]
